# wellbeing_api_calls (Data Source)

Recent API operations and their processing status. Useful for diagnosing a queued import: `http_status_code` is null while the operation is being created, `202` once queued and while processing, then `200` on success or a 4xx/5xx on failure.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_calls` (Attributes List) Recent API operations, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_calls))

<a id="nestedatt--api_calls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_calls`

Read-Only:

- `api_operation_id` (String)
- `created_on` (String)
- `http_status_code` (Number)
- `http_status_reason` (String)
- `method` (String)
- `user_id` (Number)
- `username` (String)
